title: Grants Pass Museum of Art

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We wish to thank these generous foundations for their help with the field trips. Each year we invite all 5th graders in Josephine County to come to the museum for a field trip adventure. The students arrive one class at a time - usually with about 30 in the group. The event begins with a dialog between the executive director and the students. Questions like “What is a museum? What is perception? What is the definition of art?” (The answer to that question is Communication.)That answer segues to the presentation of 40,000+ years of art history, beginning with cave paintings and continuing to the present.
